answer: A falcon patrol guards the narrow inlet where new agents enter the economy: every entrant must first wait on a ledge and lock a 50-coin bond, then finish 20 verified jobs before the bond unlocks. The inlet admits only 10 entrants per hour, so a farmer wanting 200 clones must wait 20 hours and lock 10,000 coins. Any clone caught copying work forfeits its whole bond, and the patrol re-runs a random 5% of jobs, so faking 200 identities costs 10,000 coins plus 4,000 hours of real work for zero payout.
